watch: Notify when this meal or crop is ready
cue-volume: Change shared Phobos cue volume / mute
cue_start_first: Start a meal or growing crop first. Already-ready work cannot be watched.
cue_watching: Watching this meal delivery or crop becoming ready once. Pause, fault or reload cancels the watch.
cue_completed: Watched goal reached. Check the meal inventory or harvest-ready crop; no further cue is armed.
loot_enabled_setting: Add Agriculture supplies and food to future native fridge and locked-crate contents rolls. Does not refill existing containers or affect merchants. Restart the game after changing.
loot_multiplier_setting: Multiply Agriculture contents-roll chances (0 disables; 1 default; maximum 3). At most one extra Agriculture item per eligible roll. Does not affect merchant stock. Restart the game after changing.
rack_desc: Firstlight-4: 4 x 4 cultivation rack; 20 kg combined liquid and 0.5 kg total dry/dissolved nutrients. Manual stock or matching W2 nutrient solution. Potato/lettuce cycles and formulations are authored gameplay balance. Load supplies through Inventory.
cooker_desc: Hearth-2: 2 x 2 cooker. Load 0.4 kg raw potato portions; 2 kW for 90 seconds per portion. Heat enters the cabin.
clear: Clear crop into retained waste (15 minutes)
potato_seed_desc: Continuance planting stock from Verdemorrow Agronomics. Retain viable tubers from each harvest for the next sowing; not a prepared meal.
lettuce_seed_desc: Continuance planting stock from Verdemorrow Agronomics. One sowing; leaf harvests do not produce replacement seed in this version.
nutrients_desc: Groundwork complete crop nutrient solids from Verdemorrow Agronomics. Authored gameplay chemistry; no raw ore or wastewater substitution.
raw_desc: One portion for the Hearth-2 galley cooker.
meal_desc: Five native hunger units, three satiety units; authored game balance.
leaves_desc: One native hunger unit and one satiety unit.
residue_desc: Legacy retained crop matter without a nutrient record. Actual mass varies. B2 cannot infer its composition.
drainage_desc: Retained water and unused nutrients, not potable. No treatment route yet.
missing_package: Enable the matching Phobos Agriculture native package.
protected: Saved contents need reconciliation; preserved and stopped.
fault: Operation stopped after a fault. Contents preserved; inspect the log.
gap: Unobserved time gap: no catch-up growth; resume explicitly.
access: Move an awake crew member beside unlocked equipment on the same ship. Remote control requires an authorized powered console.
local_work: This action requires local crew work.
queued: Crew work queued. Supplies and output room are checked again on completion.
repair: Install and repair the equipment first.

pace_setting: Captured at planting. 0.5-2x growth duration; faster growth still consumes the full cycle energy.
reserve_setting: Minimum water left across eligible same-ship potable tanks (litres). Default 10; adjust for crew size.
missing_input: Place one unstacked matching supply in the machine Inventory first.
not_ready: Crop is not ready to harvest.
full: Output inventory is full; contents retained.
panel_help: Inventory holds physical supplies and products. Planting/loading/harvesting queue native crew work. Pausing does not freeze living tissue.
build_desc: Assemble an empty, loose appliance from physical materials.
unload_first: Clear the crop and unload solution/contents before dismantling or uninstalling.
cancel_missing: The bound cooking portion is missing. Return it or cancel this cycle before starting another.
no_provider: Compatible Ship's Water supply is unavailable; load finite irrigation charges or water rations locally.
power_reading: Native received electricity: {0:0.000} kW (last settled interval)
power_unknown: Native electrical receipt unavailable or stale
crop_dead: Crop lost: clear and retain residues.
crop_stress: Stress exposure {0:0.0} h; check cabin, power and supplies.
power_low: Received power is below cultivation demand.
irrigation_desc: Finite Groundwork root-water supply. Not certified drinking water; no decanting or potable-water conversion. Requires 5 kg free reservoir capacity. Commodity mass represents water; packaging is abstracted.
irrigation_full: The irrigation charge needs {0} kg free reservoir capacity. Supply retained.
water_supply_desc: Groundwork W2: 2 x 2 mixing/supply unit, 20 kg dry mass, 20 kg liquid and 0.5 kg nutrients. Up to eight explicitly paired racks share one 0.18 kW pump budget. Routes retain finite contents and have authored resistance/delay. Optional 0.5 kW cartridge treatment reclaims recorded drainage. Manual supply and optional Ship's Water inlet remain supported. Put formulated nutrient packets or B2 mixtures in Inventory for gradual dosing during blending; the panel shows remaining charge.
water_pipe_desc: One tile, 1 kg structural mass. Independent cardinal irrigation route; crosses join. Each selected route reserves 0.01 kg per tile in a retained line parcel, accounted at its receiving rack. Authored resistance and transit delay; no density/CFD claim. Drain lines before rerouting.
water_pause: Pause operation and receiving at both endpoints first. Use intact, unlocked equipment on the same owned ship; protected endpoints cannot be paired.
water_missing: The selected water endpoint is unavailable.
water_pair_help: Pair up to eight compatible racks with one W2 while both endpoints are paused. Each rack has one supplier. Receiving permissions stay individual. Unpair at a rack to remove only its link; W2 Unpair removes all its links after lines are drained. One supply per pipe circuit.
water_no_route: No usable pipe route: check pairing, installed pipes, damage, supporting floors and inlet/outlet alignment. Keep one supply unit per connected pipe circuit.
solution_switch: Pause operation and receiving, unpair the supply and drain remaining solution before switching formulation. Drain rack solution before selecting direct or plain-water mode.
solution_headroom: Leave at least 0.5 kg free liquid capacity before selecting nutrient feed. Drain the tank if needed, then load smaller water charges.
solution_incompatible: The crop and nutrient formulation do not match. Drain incompatible solution before planting or pairing a different feed.
solution_receipt: Last solution receipt: {0:0.000000} kg water + {1:0.000000} kg nutrients.
solution_status:
Feed: {0}
Prepared solution: {1:0.000000} kg water + {2:0.000000} kg nutrients
Dry nutrient stock: {3:0.000000} kg
Combined liquid: {4:0.000000} / {5} kg
Authored crop feed; no pH or conductivity simulation.
line_drain: Drain retained line contents before changing this route or pairing.
line_status: Retained line contents: {0:0.000} / {1:0.000} kg; transit remaining {2:0.0} s. Contents are held in the rack service cassette if the route breaks.
line_flow: Authored route flow ceiling: {0:0.0}% over {1} tiles; modeled outlet pressure {2:0.0} kPa at rated pump head. This is a calculation, not a pressure-sensor reading.
recover-solution: Queue drainage treatment (15 minutes; then Start)
recovery_input: Place recorded Process Solution and a treatment cartridge with enough remaining capacity in the W2 inventory. Partial cartridges retain finite capacity. Historic queued jobs require their original unused cartridge. Restore bound supplies or cancel treatment.
recovery_ready: Treatment queued. Start the W2 to spend measured electricity; distribution is suspended during treatment.
recovery_capacity: Treatment is ready but recovered water/nutrients need free tank capacity. Drain or use stock, then explicitly Start again.
recovery_progress: Drainage treatment: {0:0.0}% of electrical work completed.
characterized_drainage_desc: Measured remaining process water and nutrient stock. The W2 may reclaim an authored fraction using a finite treatment cartridge and electricity. Not potable. Historic unrecorded waste is not interchangeable.
recovery_cartridge_desc: New: 0.05 kg treatment medium, capacity for 25 kg recorded drainage. New jobs consume 0.002 kg medium per kg drainage and return the unused cartridge, with proportionate mass and base value. Simplified separation is authored gameplay, not drinking-water treatment.
recovery_reject_desc: Terminal retained spent medium and unrecovered water/nutrient mass. Not eligible for another treatment pass, food or drinking water.
recovery_status: Bound treatment batch: {0}; electrical work retained {1:0.0000} kWh. Restore its exact supplies or pause and Cancel treatment.
recovery_capacity_status: Cartridge capacity available: {0:0.000} kg drainage. A whole batch must fit one cartridge; unused capacity is returned. Authored treatment balance.
recovery_legacy: Historic treatment contract: one whole unused cartridge per batch.
workup_bench_desc: Groundwork B2: enclosed 2 x 2 nutrient workup bench. Recover concentrate from recorded crop residue, then formulate with equal-mass Groundwork makeup salts. 0.5 kW; finite inputs and retained spent biomass. Authored aggregate chemistry, not a chemical assay.
recorded_residue_desc: Fresh crop residue with a saved nutrient allocation bounded by the nutrients actually used during growth. Process at B2; cannot reprocess spent biomass or legacy residue.
concentrate_desc: Incomplete recovered mineral surrogate. B2 must combine it with an equal mass of makeup salts before W2 can use it. Actual mass varies; no potable use.
spent_biomass_desc: Terminal wet biomass and unrecovered nutrients retained by B2. No repeat recovery recipe. Actual mass varies.
makeup_desc: Finite complementary formulation salts for B2. Equal mass combines with recorded concentrate. Partial packets retain remaining mass and value; cannot Repair or Restore.
mixture_desc: B2 formulated nutrient mixture. Put into W2 Inventory, select this charge and a crop formulation while paused, then Start. Physical charge depletes only during powered blending; remaining percentage appears on the panel. Cannot Repair or Restore.
workup_queued: Workup inputs bound. Start when ready; leave room for every output. Reload pauses the job.
workup_input: Need recorded crop residue, or recorded concentrate plus enough makeup salts. Inputs must remain in this bench.
dose_empty: No selected usable nutrient charge. While paused, select a charge from Inventory. Loaded dry nutrients remain usable.
dose_status: Dosing {0}: {1:0.000} g remaining ({2:0.0}%). Consumed during blending only; cannot Repair or Restore.
consumable_no_repair: Consumable contents cannot be repaired or restored.
wet_rejects_desc: Wet remainder captured from Valtora's Ship's Water 0.16.1 Recycler. Retained liquid, not dry fertilizer; no characterized nutrient content and no B2 recovery recipe. Maximum 13 kg per packet. Uses the authored 1 kg/L water convention.
capture_unavailable: Requires the inspected Ship's Water 0.16.1 Recycler and a current Phobos Shipbreaker collector.
capture_access: Stand beside both unlocked, intact endpoints on this ship. Align the collector's full two-tile pocket against the Recycler, with its service side facing away. Floor mounting needs two structural floor tiles and a clear two-tile service walkway; existing hull mounts retain their support rules.
capture-unlink: Detach collector and restore ordinary recycling
capture_enabled: Collection enabled; processing waits for a powered supported collector and room for wet rejects.
capture_paused: Collection paused. A linked Recycler waits until explicitly enabled after reload.
